subject: NovaCloud trial: procurement & commercial path — next steps
message_1_subject: NovaCloud trial: procurement & commercial path — next steps
message_1_body:
Thanks again for the call this morning — really appreciate you walking us through NovaCloud's trial goals and success criteria. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

Summary from our side:
- Primary success criteria: 10k generated tokens/day sustained over 2 weeks for the SearchAssist pilot; acceptable 95th percentile latency <250ms on p99 queries.
- Pilot duration: 30 days starting Dec 10 if procurement is in place.
- Key contacts: Samir (technical), Priya (procurement).

Procurement/commercial questions we need to lock before start:
1) Payment method: Do you prefer PO/invoice or card (we support both)? If PO, do you require a formal SOW and standard CA/contract countersign?
2) Marketplace: Are you interested in purchasing via AWS Marketplace or GCP Marketplace (that can simplify procurement for some accounts)?
3) Billing start: We typically start billing on the trial-to-paid conversion date or when paid licenses are activated. Would you prefer billing to begin on the trial start date (Dec 10) or on conversion?

Attachments: attached a short SOW draft (NovaCloud_SOW_v1.pdf) and a sample commercial term sheet to speed review.

Proposed next steps:
- Samir: confirm any technical gating criteria we should include in the SOW (e.g., dataset residency, encryption requirements).
- Priya / procurement: confirm payment method and whether a PO path or marketplace path is preferred.
- Redwood: we'll stand up trial capacity on Dec 10 pending procurement path; if PO is required, we can share an estimated invoice and DocuSign link for signature.

If helpful I can do a quick 15-min procurement sync with Priya and your finance contact this week.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference
+1 415-555-0123

--

message_2_subject: Re: NovaCloud trial: procurement & commercial path — next steps
message_2_body:
Thanks Marissa — good summary. Quick answers from our side:

1) Payment method: Procurement prefers PO/invoice for pilot workloads. We'll raise a PO once legal signs off; estimated turnaround ~7-10 business days.
2) Marketplace: Yes — we prefer AWS Marketplace if possible. That typically removes internal PO friction. If Redwood can offer the same SKU via AWS Marketplace, please let us know the listing name.
3) Billing start: We'd prefer billing to begin on conversion to paid (i.e., when the PO is accepted / contract countersigned).

Technical gating (Samir): We don't have special residency needs for the pilot; standard encryption in transit + at rest is sufficient. One ask: can we restrict logs retention to 90 days for this pilot?

Priya — looping you to confirm procurement timeline and preferred next step for legal review.

Thanks,
Samir
Senior Engineering Manager, NovaCloud
samir@novacloud.com

message_4_body:
Thanks Priya/Samir — quick operational notes from Redwood:

- We'll update the SOW to include 90-day logs retention and the technical gating Samir mentioned. Draft SOW attached for your legal (NovaCloud_SOW_v1.pdf).
- Marketplace: we can provision an AWS Marketplace listing, but publishing typically takes 2-3 weeks. Given your timeline, we'll proceed with the PO path in parallel. If Marketplace completes sooner, we can switch purchase method before conversion.
- Billing: per your ask, billing will start on conversion (i.e., when the PO is accepted / contract countersigned). For internal clarity, define "conversion" as the date the signed SOW/MSA are countersigned OR when PO is received and validated.

Next steps:
1) Redwood: send updated SOW + MSA (DocuSign link provided) by EOD Dec 10.
2) NovaCloud: legal to review and provide redlines; procurement to share expected PO issuance date (target Dec 17).
3) Technical: Samir to provide any final test dataset or traffic patterns so we can provision capacity for Dec 10 start.

Marissa will set a 15-min procurement sync for early next week to unblock legal.

-David
